title: igdo-engine-repro: a minimal reproducible orchestration kernel for Intelligent Geo-Data Objects (IGDO)
description: Fixed-seed, one-command reproducible Python subset of the IGDO-Engine orchestration kernel: microseismic (S1/S2) and InSAR Mogi cross-modality experiments, intent-driven re-planning, and planner scalability; static vs. state/intent-aware pipelines over the same node implementations.
